name: claridez
description: Toolchains y plataforma local reproducibles del monorepo privado Claridez.

scripts.db:prepare: uv --directory apps/api run python tools/local_database.py prepare
scripts.db:check: uv --directory apps/api run python tools/local_database.py check
scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py migrate --settings=claridez.settings.migration && uv --directory apps/api run python tools/local_database.py prepare
scripts.db:migrations:check: uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run --settings=claridez.settings.migration
scripts.db:reset: uv --directory apps/api run python tools/local_database.py reset
scripts.api:run: uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py api_run 127.0.0.1:8000 --settings=claridez.settings.development
scripts.auth:bootstrap: uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py auth_bootstrap --settings=claridez.settings.development
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:web
scripts.format:api: uv --directory apps/api run ruff check --fix . && uv --directory apps/api run ruff format .
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check:api && npm run format:check:web
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.build:api: uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py check --settings=claridez.settings.test && uv --directory apps/api run python -m compileall -q manage.py src tests && uv --directory apps/api run python manage.py spectacular --settings=claridez.settings.test --file openapi-schema.yaml --validate --fail-on-warn
scripts.check: npm run check:locks && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.check:all: npm run db:check && npm run db:migrations:check && npm run check && npm run test:integration
scripts.audit: npm run audit:api && npm run audit:web
